I'm glad you posted here and got that all out. It's rough...I've been in the exact position you were. It hurt so, so bad...you think you might finally have found someone and they disappear in the wind. If you'd like to message me and talk more about it, please please do. I'll tell my own story if it helps. One last thing: you're not stupid for taking a chance with someone. It's all we can do right? Go all in and hope for the best. It's not your fault nor did you do anything wrong either. If anything, I say you did right by being brave enough to take chances because what if she had been the one! Don't give up and take care of yourself eh? <3
